mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mdf_dataset_version (dataset_id, version_code, status, start_date, end_date, source_provider, source_note, row_count) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{versionCode}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{sourceProvider}, #{sourceNote}, #{rowCount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mdf_dataset_version WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(version_code, 2) AS SIGNED)), 0) FROM mdf_dataset_version WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mdf_dataset_version SET status = #{status}, qualified_at = COALESCE(#{qualifiedAt}, qualified_at), released_at = COALESCE(#{releasedAt}, released_at), source_note = COALESCE(#{sourceNote}, source_note) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mdf_dataset_version SET row_count = #{rowCount} WHERE id = #{id}
